newsitem.title: USA: Americas Society elects Mosbacher as chairman.
newsitem.headline: Americas Society elects Mosbacher as chairman.

text.p: Robert Mosbacher, former U.S. Commerce Secretary, has been named chairman of the Americas Society and the affiliated Council of the Americas, said the Americas Society.
Mosbacher, who served as Commerce Secretary under President George Bush and is chairman of the Houston-based Mosbacher Energy Co, will succeed John Avery, effective on January 1, 1997.
The Americas Society, a non-profit educational organization, informs the public about the politics, economies and cultures of countries in the Western Hemisphere.
The Council of Americas promotes economic integration, free trade and investment, and it advocates public policy discussions in Washington and in capitals abroad.
